As a Trainee at TATA MOTORS Ltd I have rich hands experience in the following area 

 Knowledge about BIW fixtures. 

 PM activity of BIW fixtures. 

 Implemented new modified fixtures. 

 Troubleshooting daily line problems regarding fixtures. 

Technical Qualification: 



Additional Certification : 

Key Functional areas during the On Job Training: 

Knowledge/Skills gained during NTTF Academics: 

Reference: 

Personal Information: 

 Maintain all documents of fixtures like pin validation, copper plate & roller changing 
schedule, PM check sheet and fixtures validation record. 

As a causal at Donaldson Ltd Company, Manesar: 

 Air cleaner assembly 

 Filter expending 

 Production maintenance of jigs and fixture. 
 
 

 Automotive service technician 

 Got awards in suraksha rakshak 
 
 

 
As a Trainee at TATA MOTORS Ltd I have rich hands experience in the following area 
Shop Name: PE_Fixtures Maintenance in BIW-1C/1B/1D 

 

Theory 
 Engineering drawing related like Interpretation of component drawing, Basic drafting. 

 Metrology related like Measurement, Limits & Fits and Tolerances etc. 

 Modern Shop Floor Practices using 7 QC tools, 5S, Kaizen, Poke-yoke etc. 

 Manufacturing Processes like ability to do basic Welding, to operate Power Tools, understanding 
of machining, casting, forging, rolling, finishing process 

 Automobile related like ability to recognize basic components & Systems like - Power 
transmission, Suspension etc. 

 Familiarization of PLC System, Basics of Timer and Counter, Logic function. 

 Robotics Engineering and IoT encompasses electronics, communication and computer science 
engineering. 

 Safety, health and environment norms and compliances. 

 Industrial Act, Material, Purchase, Store, and Inventory Management, Production Planning and 
Control, TPM. 

 

Practical 

 
 Metrology applications like- Measuring parts using Instrument (Calipers, Micrometer) & 

Inspection using Gauges (Slip, Feeler, Ring, Plug, Snap gauge etc.) 

 Computer Skills like application of MS Office (Excel, Word, and Power Point). 
 
 

 

Mr. Nitin Kumar (Center Coordinator) 
Mobile: +91 9837327513 
(NTTF Training Centre, Pantnagar) 

Mr. Manish Kumar (Supervisor) 
Mob: 8272035742 
(Tata motors Pantnagar, Uttarakhand)

Mother name: Mrs. Poonam Devi 
Languages Known: English, Hindi 
Marital Status: Single
